_comment: Spell catalogue compiled from supplements/magic 07 (SR4A p.203-211), 21 (SM p.162-174), 24 (DG p.19-20), 30 (WAR military). dvMod = modifier applied to Force/2 (rounded down), null when DV is not Force-based. Drain: Stun unless Force > Magic (then Physical); never below 1; Force max Magic x2. type P=physical M=mana; range T/LOS/(A)=area; duration I/S/P. Rows with dvVariants or [Attribute]/[Object]/[Metatype] placeholders are templates. Page numbers are ranges for the section.

spells.name: Analyze Device
spells.notes: Hits beat Object Resistance; +1 die per net hit operating the device; ignore skill defaulting modifiers.

spells.name: Analyze Truth
spells.notes: Detect whether statements are true (half-truths believed true are not detected); 1 net hit; only heard in person (not written/tech media).

spells.name: Clairaudience
spells.notes: Hear distant sounds at a movable listening point; no normal hearing meanwhile; natural hearing range only.

spells.name: Clairvoyance
spells.notes: See distant scenes; no normal or astral perception meanwhile; augmented vision does not work; cannot be used to target spells.

spells.name: Combat Sense
spells.notes: Each hit +1 die Reaction on Surprise Tests and when defending vs. ranged and melee attacks.

spells.name: Detect Enemies
spells.notes: Living targets with hostile intentions toward the subject (not traps, not random shooters; detects ambushes).

spells.name: Detect Enemies, Extended
spells.notes: Living targets with hostile intentions toward the subject (not traps, not random shooters; detects ambushes).

spells.name: Detect Individual
spells.notes: A named individual the caster knows or has met.

spells.name: Detect Life
spells.notes: All living beings (not spirits): number and relative location; useless in a crowd.

spells.name: Detect Life, Extended
spells.notes: All living beings (not spirits): number and relative location; useless in a crowd.

spells.name: Detect [Life Form]
spells.notes: One life-form type per spell (orks, elves, dragons…).

spells.name: Detect [Life Form], Extended
spells.notes: One life-form type per spell (orks, elves, dragons…).

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.notes: Foci, spells, wards, lodges, spirits; not Awakened characters/critters, astral signatures or permanent spell effects.

spells.name: Detect Magic, Extended
spells.notes: Foci, spells, wards, lodges, spirits; not Awakened characters/critters, astral signatures or permanent spell effects.

spells.name: Detect [Object]
spells.notes: One object type per spell (guns, computers, explosives…).

spells.name: Mindlink
spells.notes: Mental link with one voluntary subject (talk, emotions, images); 1 hit establishes it; must stay within range.

spells.name: Mind Probe
spells.notes: See table; target aware of probing; one piece of information per Complex Action; further uses within hours = target's Willpower: −2 dice per previous attempt.

spells.name: Antidote
spells.notes: Before the toxin does damage; + net hits dice on the Toxin Resistance Test (after the fact the GM may allow easing side effects).

spells.name: Cure Disease
spells.notes: Any time after infection; + net hits dice to Disease Resistance; does not heal damage already done.

spells.name: Decrease [Attribute] (negative)
spells.notes: One version per Physical and Mental attribute (not Special: Initiative, Edge, Essence, Magic, Resonance); affects natural and augmented attributes; target resists with the attribute affected; reduce by net hits; 0 Physical = paralyzed, 0 Mental = mindless; derived stats change (e.g. Intuition affects Initiative; Willpower removes Stun boxes).

spells.name: Detox
spells.notes: Force ≥ toxin base DV; 1 net hit removes all side effects (not damage).

spells.name: Heal
spells.notes: Heals hits boxes of Physical damage; hits can instead shave 1 Combat Turn each off the time to become permanent. Only once per set of injuries.

spells.name: Hibernate
spells.notes: Voluntary/unconscious subject; metabolism slowed by a factor = hits (4 hits: 1 day of air lasts 4 days).

spells.name: Increase [Attribute]
spells.notes: Voluntary; Force ≥ the (augmented) attribute; +hits to the attribute; one Increase spell per attribute at a time; derived stats change.

spells.name: Increase Reflexes
spells.notes: Level thresholds: 2 hits = +1 Initiative +1 IP; 3 = +2/+2; 4 (max) = +3/+3. One at a time; max 4 IP for any character.

spells.name: Oxygenate
spells.notes: +1 Body die per hit vs. suffocation, strangulation, inhaled gas; breathe underwater.

spells.name: Prophylaxis
spells.notes: +1 die per hit to resist infection, drugs, toxins (also beneficial drugs: −1 effect per hit; 2+ hits prevent alcohol effects).

spells.name: Resist Pain
spells.notes: Each hit removes the effect of one box of damage on each track (not the damage); once per set of injuries; dissipates if damage rises or heals; a full track still means unconscious.

spells.name: Stabilize
spells.notes: On a filled Physical track; Force ≥ overflow damage; full permanence time must pass (hits reduce by 1 Combat Turn each); prevents Physical Damage Overflow.

spells.name: Confusion
spells.notes: −1 die to all tests per net hit (distraction).

spells.name: Mass Confusion
spells.notes: −1 die to all tests per net hit (distraction).

spells.name: Chaos
spells.notes: Physical version; affects technology too.

spells.name: Chaotic World
spells.notes: Physical version; affects technology too.

spells.name: Entertainment
spells.notes: Hits = how captivating; Trid version also affects sensors.

spells.name: Trid Entertainment
spells.notes: Hits = how captivating; Trid version also affects sensors.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.notes: Hits = threshold to see the subject; still detectable by non-visual senses and astral perception; Target Hidden modifier (p.150) for attackers; Improved also fools technological sensors (warps light).

spells.name: Improved Invisibility
spells.notes: Hits = threshold to see the subject; still detectable by non-visual senses and astral perception; Target Hidden modifier (p.150) for attackers; Improved also fools technological sensors (warps light).

spells.name: Mask
spells.notes: New appearance of the same size/shape (voice, scent too); hits = threshold; Physical Mask also affects sensors.

spells.name: Physical Mask
spells.notes: New appearance of the same size/shape (voice, scent too); hits = threshold; Physical Mask also affects sensors.

spells.name: Phantasm
spells.notes: Any object/creature/scene the caster has seen, up to the area size; Trid version also fools sensors.

spells.name: Trid Phantasm
spells.notes: Any object/creature/scene the caster has seen, up to the area size; Trid version also fools sensors.

spells.name: Hush
spells.notes: Damps sound: sonic attacks (and critter sonic powers like Paralyzing Howl) reduced −1 per hit; Silence also jams alarms, sonar, tactical comms and technological sonic weapons.

spells.name: Silence
spells.notes: Damps sound: sonic attacks (and critter sonic powers like Paralyzing Howl) reduced −1 per hit; Silence also jams alarms, sonar, tactical comms and technological sonic weapons.

spells.name: Stealth
spells.notes: Subject makes less or no noise (not things she does not touch); hits = hearing threshold; a won Shadowing/Infiltration test can still keep her unnoticed.

spells.name: Armor
spells.notes: Ballistic and Impact armor = hits, cumulative with worn armor.

spells.name: Control Actions
spells.notes: Controls the body like a puppeteer; tests suffer a dice pool modifier = target's Willpower; costs the caster a Simple Action to control; Mob Control: individually or as a group (one Simple Action).

spells.name: Mob Control
spells.notes: Controls the body like a puppeteer; tests suffer a dice pool modifier = target's Willpower; costs the caster a Simple Action to control; Mob Control: individually or as a group (one Simple Action).

spells.name: Control Emotions
spells.notes: Overwhelming chosen emotion; acting against it −2 dice; switch emotion with a Simple Action.

spells.name: Mob Mood
spells.notes: Overwhelming chosen emotion; acting against it −2 dice; switch emotion with a Simple Action.

spells.name: Control Thoughts
spells.notes: Seizes the mind; commands by Simple Action; compelled to obey.

spells.name: Mob Mind
spells.notes: Seizes the mind; commands by Simple Action; compelled to obey.

spells.name: Fling
spells.notes: Hurls one object up to Force kg with Strength = ½ Magic; normal Ranged Combat Test.

spells.name: Ice Sheet
spells.notes: Slippery ice: Agility + Reaction threshold = hits to avoid falling prone; vehicles make a Crash Test (p.178); melts 1 m²/minute.

spells.name: Ignite
spells.notes: Catches fire when permanent; objects: net hits ≥ Object Resistance; living: opposed vs. Body (+Counterspelling): Force boxes of Fire damage on turn 1, +1 per turn, resisted with Body + half Impact armor; may detonate ammo/explosives.

spells.name: Influence
spells.notes: One post-hypnotic suggestion; the victim can resist with a Willpower test when confronted with its wrongness; the caster can withdraw it.

spells.name: Levitate
spells.notes: Threshold = 1 per 200 kg; movement rate = Force × net hits m/turn; opposed vs. holder's Strength + Body (spell Force × 2) to take an object away; unwilling living being: target's Strength + Body; self-levitation allowed; flung objects: Ranged Attack, Stun damage set by the GM.

spells.name: Light
spells.notes: Mobile point of light, radius Force m; each hit counters −1 die of visibility penalty; cannot blind.

spells.name: Magic Fingers
spells.notes: Invisible hands, Strength and Agility = hits; skills at −2 for fine control.

spells.name: Mana Barrier
spells.notes: Barrier with Force = net hits; stops spirits, foci, dual beings, spells; target behind it adds Force to resistance; threshold +1 per 3 Force for objects (p.194).

spells.name: Petrify
spells.notes: Opposed vs. Body (+Counterspelling); Force ≥ target Body; living tissue only; target unconscious; barrier Armor = Body + net hits.

spells.name: Physical Barrier
spells.notes: Force-field wall/dome with 1 Armor and 1 Structure per hit; dome radius/height = normal radius or wall height/length = Force; regenerates damage at the start of each turn; collapses if penetrated; not on the astral plane; molecule-sized things pass; −1 visibility penalty through it.

spells.name: Poltergeist
spells.notes: Whirls small objects (≤1 kg): −2 visibility, 2 boxes Stun/turn (Reaction + Impact armor) — more in cluttered places or Physical with dangerous debris.

spells.name: Shadow
spells.notes: Globe of darkness (radius Force m), −1 per hit (max −6).

spells.name: Shapechange / (Critter) Form
spells.notes: Voluntary; into a normal critter whose base Body is within ±2 of her own (Critters, p.292); +1 to each base attribute per hit; Mental attributes unchanged; gear not transformed; can cast but not speak. Critter Form = one specific animal per spell.

spells.name: Turn to Goo
spells.notes: Opposed vs. Body (+Counterspelling); Force ≥ target Body; target unconscious; goo barrier Armor = Body + net hits.

spells.name: Corrode [Object]
spells.notes: Acid damage affecting only the specified object (Corrode Wall, Melt Electronics, Sludge Armor); touch.

spells.name: Melt [Object]
spells.notes: Single target, acid, object-specific.

spells.name: Sludge [Object]
spells.notes: Area, acid, object-specific.

spells.name: Firewater
spells.notes: Burning water: both Fire and Water damage (ignites things; knockdown; shorts electronics); Physical, half Impact armor; fire-resistance upgrade adds its full rating; chemical seal/contact toxin protection also protects.

spells.name: Napalm
spells.notes: Area version of Firewater.

spells.name: One Less [Metatype/Species]
spells.notes: Death Touch variant for one species/metatype (biological species only).

spells.name: Slay [Metatype/Species]
spells.notes: Manabolt variant.

spells.name: Slaughter [Metatype/Species]
spells.notes: Manaball variant.

spells.name: Ram [Object]
spells.notes: Shatter variant, one object type (Ram Door…).

spells.name: Wreck [Object]
spells.notes: Powerbolt variant.

spells.name: Demolish [Object]
spells.notes: Powerball variant.

spells.name: Shattershield
spells.notes: Destroys mana barriers: touch the barrier's physical component or astral form; the barrier resists with Force (Structure) + Counterspelling.

spells.name: Analyze Magic
spells.notes: Analyze a spell, spirit, astral form, focus or magical effect as if assensing (Assensing Table, SR4A p.191); gives no astral sight; to analyze astral-only things the subject must be astrally perceiving/projecting.

spells.name: Astral Clairvoyance
spells.notes: Clairvoyance for astral sight; replaces the subject's own assensing; cannot target spells; subject must be astrally active.

spells.name: Borrow Sense
spells.notes: Borrow one sense of a target (target resists; Perception hits limited to the caster's net hits); target stays in control; switch sense with a Simple Action; senses the subject lacks can be borrowed; astral sight is a separate sense; no augmented senses/astral sight through it; no spell targeting through it.

spells.name: Animal Sense
spells.notes: Restricted to non-sapient, non-paranormal animals.

spells.name: Eyes of the Pack
spells.notes: Voluntary targets, sight only; switching member = Simple Action.

spells.name: Catalog
spells.notes: Itemized list of all non-living items in the area (beat each item's Object Resistance threshold; net hits = detail; forgotten after the spell).

spells.name: Diagnose
spells.notes: General health, illnesses, injuries (Detection Spell Results table).

spells.name: Enhance Aim
spells.notes: Voluntary: each hit reduces the Range category by one level for ranged attacks; stacks with scopes/smartlink/etc.

spells.name: Hawkeye
spells.notes: Voluntary: +1 die per hit to visual Perception tests; stacks with other aids.

spells.name: [Sense] Cryptesthesia
spells.notes: Advanced Clairvoyance/Clairaudience: provides an augmented sense (low-light, thermographic, smell, ultrasound…) at a chosen point; one spell per sense; the subject need not have the sense; cannot target spells.

spells.name: Mana Window
spells.notes: Clairvoyance past mana barriers on the physical plane (barrier resists with Force; does not alert its creator).

spells.name: Astral Window
spells.notes: As Mana Window, for assensing past astral mana barriers (subject astrally active).

spells.name: Spatial Sense
spells.notes: Awareness of layout (landscape, architecture; 3-D; hidden shafts/rooms/tunnels) per Detection Results table; no security features or living things; mana-barrier areas are "blank spots".

spells.name: Spatial Sense, Extended
spells.notes: Extended version.

spells.name: Mindnet
spells.notes: Mindlink for a group of voluntary people (free talk, images, emotions within range); threshold = number of participants (excluding the caster).

spells.name: Mindnet, Extended
spells.notes: Extended area.

spells.name: Thermographic Vision
spells.notes: Voluntary subject gets thermographic vision (as cyber, SR4A p.340).

spells.name: Night Vision
spells.notes: Low-light vision (as cyber).

spells.name: Thought Recognition
spells.notes: Scans a target's surface thoughts for a chosen word/phrase/sound/image (less intrusive than Mind Probe): checks whether the target has something in mind.

spells.name: Area Thought Recognition
spells.notes: Scans everyone in the area.

spells.name: Translate
spells.notes: Low-level telepathic link with one chosen target for mutual understanding of speech (translates intent, not delicate phrasing); sapient language users only (sasquatch, merrow…), not animals; net hits = quality.

spells.name: Alleviate Addiction
spells.notes: Each net hit lowers the addiction level by one for one addiction at a time; effects return when the spell ends; not for Focus Addiction.

spells.name: Alleviate Allergy
spells.notes: As above for one allergy.

spells.name: Awaken
spells.notes: Wakes an unconscious/sleeping target while sustained; does not cure Stun (modifiers remain); threshold = Stun modifiers (1 if asleep); relapse afterwards.

spells.name: Crank
spells.notes: Voluntary: each hit ≈ 1 hour of sleep; abuse may cause addiction to magical sleep deprivation.

spells.name: Decrease Reflexes
spells.notes: Target resists Reaction + Counterspelling; Force must be ≥ target Reaction; each net hit −1 Initiative and −1 Initiative Pass (minimum 1).

spells.name: Enabler
spells.notes: Opposite of Antidote: target resists Body + Counterspelling; each net hit −1 die to the Toxin Resistance Test; must be sustained until the toxin takes effect.

spells.name: Fast
spells.notes: Voluntary: ignore hunger/thirst (each hit = one skipped meal); symptoms hit when it ends; >72 h dangerous.

spells.name: Healthy Glow
spells.notes: Cosmetic; wears off with lifestyle.

spells.name: Intoxication
spells.notes: Resist Body + Counterspelling (ingestion-vector protection applies); each net hit = 1 box Fatigue; Antidote/Detox negate.

spells.name: Nutrition
spells.notes: Voluntary: lives off pure mana (1 hit = a few hours); abuse risks addiction.

spells.name: Stim
spells.notes: Voluntary: skip sleep (each hit = one night); consequences after; >72 h dangerous.

spells.name: Agony
spells.notes: Each net hit = 1 box of illusory Physical damage; boxes filled = incapacitated; vanishes when the spell ends.

spells.name: Mass Agony
spells.notes: Area.

spells.name: Bugs
spells.notes: Insects crawling on the body; −1 die per net hit if the target carries on; > Willpower = loses control.

spells.name: Swarm
spells.notes: Area.

spells.name: Camouflage
spells.notes: Each net hit −1 die to visual Perception and ranged attacks against the subject (living viewers).

spells.name: Physical Camouflage
spells.notes: Also works against technological sensors (as listed in the book).

spells.name: Chaff
spells.notes: Chaos variant affecting only sensors: each hit over the Object Resistance threshold −1 sensor rating.

spells.name: Flak
spells.notes: Area.

spells.name: Double Image
spells.notes: Insubstantial double of the subject mimicking his actions; caster has limited control.

spells.name: Physical Double Image
spells.notes: Also fools sensors.

spells.name: Dream
spells.notes: Crafted dream sent to a sleeper (often cast by ritual spellcasting); nightmares block Stun recovery and rest.

spells.name: Foreboding
spells.notes: Feelings of danger; −1 die per net hit to those who stay; > Willpower may flee/curl up.

spells.name: Hot Potato (Single-sense)
spells.notes: All metal feels burning hot; if not dropped, modifier = net hits.

spells.name: Orgasm (Single-sense)
spells.notes: −1 die per net hit; incapacitated if > Willpower.

spells.name: Orgy
spells.notes: Area.

spells.name: [Sense] Removal
spells.notes: −1 die per net hit to Perception with that sense (implants/sensors affected); one spell per sense.

spells.name: Mass [Sense] Removal
spells.notes: Area.

spells.name: Stink
spells.notes: −1 die per net hit to all actions (gagging); incapacitated if > Willpower.

spells.name: Stench
spells.notes: Area (the book lists LOS).

spells.name: Sound Barrier
spells.notes: Perimeter of silence (Silence variant) affecting sounds crossing the border, devices, infrasound and ultrasound.

spells.name: Vehicle Mask
spells.notes: Physical Mask for vehicles/drones (similar size); modifies sound/smell and Signature: each net hit raises/lowers the modifier by 1.

spells.name: Alter Memory
spells.notes: Add/alter/erase one memory; every Force months or when shown evidence, victim rolls Willpower only; each hit reduces the caster's hits; at 0 the memory returns.

spells.name: Alter Temperature
spells.notes: ±5 °C per hit.

spells.name: Animate
spells.notes: Moves a non-living object according to its structure; beat Object Resistance (heavier than 200 kg: raise threshold); Simple Action control; max movement Force m/turn; held object: Opposed Force × 2 vs Strength + Body.

spells.name: Mass Animate
spells.notes: Area.

spells.name: Astral Armor
spells.notes: Astral Armor spell: each hit = 1 point of mystic armor (astral only).

spells.name: Bind
spells.notes: Target resists Strength + Counterspelling; each net hit −1 Agility; at 0 bound (crawl at ¼ speed; dodge with penalty = net hits); break free Strength + Body vs Force × 2; works on drones' moving parts.

spells.name: Net
spells.notes: Area.

spells.name: Mana Bind
spells.notes: Living/magical single target.

spells.name: Mana Net
spells.notes: Area against living/magical.

spells.name: Calm Animal
spells.notes: Non-sapient animals (normal or paranormal) non-aggressive (still defend).

spells.name: Calm Pack
spells.notes: Area.

spells.name: Catfall
spells.notes: Hits × Force metres of safe fall (excess is subtracted before damage).

spells.name: Clean [Element]
spells.notes: Removes impurities from an element (Clean Air/Water…); 1 hit slightly muddy water, 4–5 contaminated runoff.

spells.name: Compel Truth
spells.notes: Target can only speak truth as he believes it (may stay silent).

spells.name: Control Animal
spells.notes: Non-sapient animals; commands as Simple Action.

spells.name: Control Pack
spells.notes: Area.

spells.name: Deflection
spells.notes: Each hit +1 die to defend against ranged physical attacks.

spells.name: [Element] Aura
spells.notes: Aura (Flame, Electrical, Cold…): melee DV +hits of elemental damage (half Impact armor); successful melee hits against the subject also force the attacker to resist the aura's DV = Force.

spells.name: [Element] Wall
spells.notes: Wall up to Force m high/long (or dome radius/height Force÷2), width up to 1 m; contact inflicts elemental damage DV = Force; solid walls (earth, ice) have Armor and Structure = Spellcasting hits; fire/smoke walls block vision, not attacks.

spells.name: Fashion
spells.notes: Re-tailors clothing (no protection change; same coverage).

spells.name: Fix
spells.notes: Repairs non-living materials: beat Object Resistance; weight ≤ Force × hits kg; each hit repairs 1 Structure or 1 box; pieces must be present; once per damage set.

spells.name: Gecko Crawl
spells.notes: Walk on vertical/overhead surfaces at Force × hits m/turn.

spells.name: Glue
spells.notes: Bonds target to a surface with Strength = Force; Opposed Force × 2 vs separator's Strength + Body; torn if Body/Structure < Force (DV = difference).

spells.name: Glue Strip
spells.notes: Area.

spells.name: Interference
spells.notes: Jams signals with Signal rating < hits (as a jammer).

spells.name: Lock
spells.notes: Holds a door/portal closed with Strength = Force; opening: Strength + Body vs Force × 2.

spells.name: Mana Static
spells.notes: Creates background count 1 per hit (affects everyone incl. the caster); once permanent it recedes 1 point per hour.

spells.name: Makeover
spells.notes: Full cosmetic makeover (voluntary).

spells.name: Mist
spells.notes: Fog: visibility modifier = hits, −1 per Combat Turn as it dissipates.

spells.name: Offensive Mana Barrier
spells.notes: Mana Barrier that also zaps spirits/dual beings/astral forms: Physical DV = Force.

spells.name: Preserve
spells.notes: Slows decay of inert organic matter by a factor equal to hits (forensics, material links).

spells.name: Pulse
spells.notes: EM burst: erases RFID tags, may affect non-optical/non-hardened electronics (beat Object Resistance); disrupts wireless briefly.

spells.name: Reinforce
spells.notes: Object ≤ Magic m²: each hit +1 Armor and Structure.

spells.name: Shape [Material]
spells.notes: Move/reshape a volume of a material (beat Object Resistance); move rate = net hits m/turn; connected material loses Force Structure/Combat Turn; stays shaped; one spell per material.

spells.name: Spirit Barrier
spells.notes: Mana Barrier affecting only spirits and spirit powers (materialized spirits impeded).

spells.name: Spirit Zapper
spells.notes: Offensive version against spirits only.

spells.name: Sterilize
spells.notes: Kills microorganisms and destroys skin flakes, hairs, blood: −1 die per hit to collecting/using the biomaterial as forensic evidence; cannot be used as a material link; does not affect living creatures' internal flora. (Also destroys FAB III, file 17.)

spells.name: Disrupt [Focus]
spells.notes: Damage to an active focus's astral form: if damage ≥ focus Force, it is disrupted (inactive); the temporary damage heals at the start of the next Combat Turn; the owner reactivates with a Simple Action; disrupting a sustaining focus disrupts its spell; projecting magicians cannot reactivate until returning to their body. One spell per focus type; stacked foci need damage ≥ combined Force.

spells.name: Destroy [Free Spirit]
spells.notes: Slay variant for one specific free spirit; the formula must incorporate the spirit formula (counts as a copy of the formula).

spells.name: [Sense] Link
spells.notes: Mindlink variant tapping one of the target's senses (Sight Link, Astral Perception Link, Thermographic Vision Link…).

spells.name: Passenger
spells.notes: Borrow Sense variant: all the target's senses.

spells.name: Alleviate Nausea
spells.notes: Each net hit reduces incapacitation by 1 Combat Turn; while sustained the target doesn't double wound modifiers.

spells.name: Nauseate
spells.notes: Resist Body + Counterspelling; incapacitated 1 Combat Turn per net hit (max 3).

spells.name: Decontamination
spells.notes: Net hits = extra dice to the Radiation Resistance Test (does not heal damage).

spells.name: False Impression
spells.notes: Falsifies what magical senses perceive of a single sustained/quickened spell, aura or astral form (can't create auras).

spells.name: Manascape
spells.notes: Same for an entire area (background count, multiple auras…).

spells.name: Firewater Aura
spells.notes: Fire + Water elemental aura (see SM Firewater).

spells.name: Napalm Wall
spells.notes: Fire + Water wall.

spells.name: Radiation Shield
spells.notes: Radiation protection equal to hits (as radiation shielding, Arsenal p.50).

spells.name: Radiation Barrier
spells.notes: Dome version.

spells.name: [Element] Grenade
spells.notes: Elemental ball (acid, cold, electricity, fire, blast, ice, light, metal, sand, smoke, sound, water) launched like a grenade; scatter 3D6 m − 2 m per net hit; detonates on a Simple Action or end of turn; must be sustained until it explodes; DV = Force + net hits; physical object
spells.restricted: Forbidden; formula cost x2, Availability x2

spells.name: Sending
spells.notes: One-way mindlink to everyone in the area; targets resist with Willpower (+ Counterspelling)
spells.restricted: Forbidden; formula cost x2, Availability x2

spells.name: Broadcast
spells.notes: Extended-area Sending
spells.restricted: Forbidden; formula cost x2, Availability x2

spells.name: Calm Mind
spells.notes: Each hit reduces a psychological dice pool penalty by 1 (fear, psychosis, phobia, cyberpsychosis; not mentor/paragon penalties); quickening can make it persist
spells.restricted: Forbidden; formula cost x2, Availability x2

spells.name: Designate
spells.notes: Mimics a target designator; hits = net hits for indirect fire; visible-spectrum laser by default (thermo/radar if the caster has those senses)
spells.restricted: Forbidden; formula cost x2, Availability x2

spells.name: Flash
spells.notes: −1 vision dice per net hit (decaying 1/turn for 2 turns); halved vs flare compensation; also affects onlookers within 2× radius at half penalty
spells.restricted: Forbidden; formula cost x2, Availability x2

spells.name: Flicker
spells.notes: Mana version of Flash; ignores flare compensation
spells.restricted: Forbidden; formula cost x2, Availability x2

spells.name: [Element] Cloud
spells.notes: Sphere of diameter = Force; suppressive fire zone, DV = Force + elemental effect
spells.restricted: Forbidden; formula cost x2, Availability x2

spells.name: Recharge
spells.notes: Recharges electronics; hits must exceed Object Resistance
spells.restricted: Forbidden; formula cost x2, Availability x2

spells.name: Slow
spells.notes: Movement in the area limited to 1 m/s; ends if moving mass > 200 kg per hit; used for HALO jumps
spells.restricted: Forbidden; formula cost x2, Availability x2
